meanings.en: once, at one time in the past

meanings.en: to have to, to be forced to
meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'йтись'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'had to, it fell to', paired with 'приходиться'.

examples.trans: I'm going to have to torture you.
We had to wait a long time.

examples.text: Ты что, очкарик, не понимаешь? Мне тебя мучить придётся.

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'фессия'). Common feminine noun meaning 'profession' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ожаление'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'regret (unfortunately)' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Unfortunately, such is our life.
